snippet.title: [AFANTASIA] Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming soon! Add [AFANTASIA] to your Steam Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336670/AFANTASIA/

With immersive soundscapes, striking pixel art, and dynamic gameplay, [AFANTASIA] is a narrative exploration adventure that blurs the lines between the real and unreal, as a young boy must come to terms with who he is and who he could become.

A boy wakes at the pier in his quiet hometown of Tempo with no memories of his past. The only thing he knows for certain is that he must go to the city.
Guided by Intrusion, a mysterious voice in his head, he relives the memories and regrets of the town’s inhabitants, drawing ever closer to the truth of who he is and who he might become.

Can you know who you are without knowing your past? Can imagination alone shape someone new in its place?

[AFANTASIA] is a story about accepting who you are... and who you could be.
